subject: info-af-b
title: INFO.AF.B.------IST.F.ACT.
description: Chart 3 of 3 on book p. 77 (WAM-19). INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; IST-F-ACT is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT (social reality) and INFO-COMP (information compression), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From SOC-RT: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From PHY-U-P: RT-OP (reality options). From RT-OP: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From INFO-COMP: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: ASP-ES (aspect essence). From ASP-ES: IST-F (isolated focus), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
